given: the analytics capability and the finance.manage_folio masking pattern exist only on feat/folio-payments, not on main
then: blocks: s1. Resolved by building on feat/folio-payments, where analytics exists; the pull request targets that branch until analytics reaches main. The portfolio gates a Property by the analytics capability and masks money as getPropertyAnalytics does

given: a Staff Member reaching at least one Property, whatever their role
then: no new permission: the analytics pattern applies, because the analytics screen already lets every reader see operational figures and masks money behind finance.manage_folio, and Owner and Manager and Finance are the holders of finance.manage_folio so a portfolio.read permission would add a migration and no new reader. They get one row per reached Property

given: a Staff Member with organization_wide reach in an Organization of five active Properties
then: five rows come back

given: a Staff Member assigned two of five Properties
then: two rows come back and the other three are absent, with no count and no placeholder

situation: A Property they do not reach
given: a Property of the same Organization the Staff Member is not assigned to
then: it is absent, indistinguishable from a Property that does not exist

given: a Property whose status is archived
when: an organization_wide Owner asks for the portfolio
then: it is absent: app.accessible_property_ids() admits only active Properties (ADR 0040)

given: a signed-in user with no membership, or a membership reaching no active Property
then: an empty list comes back and no error says why

given: a Staff Member reaching one Property
then: one row comes back; the backend does not refuse a single-Property viewer, the screen decides whether to show the destination

given: the Organization's Subscription is past_due
then: the rows come back: past_due is a grace period that gate 1 admits (ADR 0040)

given: the Subscription is suspended or cancelled
then: an empty list comes back, the same answer as having nothing

given: two reached Properties, the analytics capability enabled for one and not the other
then: both rows come back; the second is marked not entitled with every figure null, so an Owner sees it was withheld instead of concluding it is missing

given: a Property entitled to the portfolio but without the maintenance capability
then: its open-maintenance figure is null, never 0, because a zero reads as nothing open; the other figures are unaffected

given: a reader without finance.manage_folio
then: occupancy and the counts come back, every money figure is null on every row

given: two Properties whose currencies differ, which ADR 0036 allows
then: each row carries its own currency and its own balance, and the response holds no money total that adds across currencies

given: two Properties with 10 of 20 and 30 of 40 units occupied
then: the total is 40 occupied of 60 sellable as counts, not the average of two percentages and not a rounded percentage

given: a Property with units out of order
when: occupied and sellable units are counted
then: sellable units are leaf units (no child unit, ADR 0025) except a unit whose own status is out_of_service or whose room is, with no in-house Stay (ADR 0032, a room out of order holds its beds); an in-house unit is always counted, so occupied never exceeds sellable. A blocked unit stays sellable

given: a Property with no rooms or every unit out of order
then: sellable is 0 and occupied is 0 and the backend computes no ratio; analytics shows 0 percent here (AN-S1-03) and the portfolio deliberately does not, so the screen can show a dash

given: a Property with three Reservations due today, one already checked in
then: arrivals still to come is 2, counted on that Property's own business date

given: a Property with two in-house Stays due out today or overdue and one already checked out
then: departures still to come is 2: Stays still in house whose end date is today or earlier, so an overdue Stay counts because it still has to leave; one already checked out does not

given: a Property with requests in open and done states
then: the figure counts requests not yet done or cancelled; the exact statuses are an open fact to read from the maintenance module, not guessed

given: a Property whose Folios carry charges, payments and reversals
then: the figure is the sum of positive Folio balances, each balance a sum of lines (ADR 0015), so a reversed charge (ADR 0041) and a recorded payment lower it

given: two Properties in different time zones, one already past midnight
then: each row is evaluated on its own business date (ADR 0021) and carries that date; there is no portfolio-wide today

given: a Property whose wall clock passed midnight and whose business day has not closed
then: the figures belong to the open business date, not the calendar date (ADR 0034)

given: two Properties with a check-in committing between their reads
then: every row is read in one SQL statement, so the whole answer shares one snapshot, and is stamped with as_of, so the comparison cannot straddle the check-in

given: a Staff Member of Organization A and Properties of Organization B
then: no row of Organization B appears

given: a Staff Member active in two Organizations, and a read that names one Organization id
then: rows come only from the Organization named, never both; the application has no active-Organization concept, so the read takes the Organization id, and deleting that filter must fail a test because accessible_property_ids() spans both

given: a Resident signed in to the Portal
then: nothing comes back

given: Properties with equal names, and names differing in case
then: order is by name then id, the same on every read

given: an Organization reaching more than 200 Properties
then: the read is refused with a typed error, never silently truncated, because a comparison missing rows is worse than none

given: one, two and twelve reached Properties
then: the answer is one statement over the reached Properties whatever their number, so the gates are set-based and not a loop of the single-Property reads

given: a returned row
when: the screen offers to open that Property
then: the row carries the Property id, which is what the switcher takes

given: a Property is unassigned after the first read
then: the second read omits it; nothing is cached across requests

given: a check-in reversed after the Guest was counted occupied (ADR 0022)
then: occupied units no longer include that Guest

given: a read made without withOrganizationContext
then: policies see a null user and return nothing, so it fails as empty instead of leaking

given: any request for the portfolio
then: portfolio.viewed is logged with actor, Organization, Property count and outcome ok or empty or refused or failed, including when the read throws; it carries counts only, never a figure or a Property name. The workspace has no semantic-event sink yet, so this is a structured console.info and console.error as its other reads do, and an Observatory sink is a later change

given: the mockup's Charged this month tile
then: deferred: it needs a definition first, which month and whether reversals net out (ADR 0015 and 0041)

given: the mockup's sparkline
then: deferred: the mockup draws it from a sine of the Property id so no real series exists

given: Properties in different currencies
then: deferred: it needs a rate source and a rule for which date's rate

given: an archived Property with financial history
when: an Owner wants it in the portfolio
then: deferred: ADR 0040 says this is a new read-only path decided when reporting exists, not a widening of accessible_property_ids()

given: the contract exists
then: out_of_scope for this card: empty, one, many, loading, refused, every locale and RTL are the screen's rows, designed when it is built
